protocol: One input ablation on the unaugmented setwise baseline: replace absolute RMS slots 30 and 61 by constant zero in all roles. Keep all 62 coordinates, the other 60 values, network shape, seed, objective, optimizer and training plan fixed. No augmentation, new level gate, cutoff-rule change or label change.

gates.training: >=99% precision cutoff; aggregate recall>=80%, exact sets>=70%; each 3/4/5 distinct-pitch exact sets>=70%; zero silence false outputs
gates.calibration_and_test: each: precision>=95%, recall>=80%, exact sets>=70%; each 3/4/5 distinct-pitch exact sets>=70%; zero silence false outputs
gates.continuous: only after all representation gates; existing full CURRENT identity, >=5pp ordinary gain; no per-label presence/longest-hold loss, wrong-pitch or extra-gap growth on either recording

scope: One CPU GitHub job, no new uploads, no local recorded processing, no label changes, no installation or promotion.
effective_example_counts: Inherited direct-spectrum generator: train 16384, calibration 4096, test 4096; same seeds, source roles, crop context, gains and clocks.

harmonic_parameters.pooling: training mixtures and pitches for one coordinate scaler; pitch-context convolutions with shared readout

model_parameters.normalization: training-only mean/std per shared coordinate over mixtures and pitches

hypothesis: Absolute mixture RMS is repeated over all pitch rows and may carry training-generator correlations that transfer poorly between source takes. Suppressing its two explicit inputs tests that route without changing network capacity or initialization. This is a hypothesis, not a demonstrated cause of held-out errors.
limitations: The two absolute-level inputs are suppressed; the existing relative-power floors and clipping remain. Global-gain invariance holds above numeric floors only, not at all quiet levels.
Removing absolute level may increase noise or quiet-input false positives. No compensating level gate is added; original silence, held-out precision and continuous false/gap gates remain.

All 62 slots remain so seeded network initialization and parameter count (14465) match the unaugmented setwise baseline. The 60 relative coordinates are bit-identical on the same input. Active learned input information changes by design.
The model still sees pitch-context boundaries through zero padding and the same source timbres. This experiment addresses neither shortcut nor proves either caused the transfer failure.
All 555 source labels and original roles remain, including unresolved source-content disagreements. No exclusion, relabeling, top-k inference, held-out fitting or cutoff retune.
Previously inspected held-out roles remain disjoint from fitting but are not a fresh blind evaluation of the research program.
Sustained sampled pitch sets and Python timing do not establish string lanes, unison multiplicity, attacks, MIDI delivery, allocation, native deadlines or live readiness.
decision: Reject immediately if the training complete-chord gate fails. Otherwise score both untouched roles, then continuous recordings only if both pass. No retune or automatic rerun.

training_plan_identity.encoding: SHA256 of decompressed JSON bytes; gzip timestamp excluded

objective.name: mean_bce_plus_setwise_logsumexp_v1
objective.base: Mean BCEWithLogits over all mixture/pitch cells
objective.positive: log(1 + sum over true pitches exp(-logit))
objective.negative: log(1 + sum over false pitches exp(logit))
objective.additional: Sum of positive and negative terms per mixture, then batch mean; no division by polarity or pitch count
objective.silence: Empty true set contributes zero; all false pitches remain in the negative term
objective.inference: Unchanged sigmoid outputs and train-only 99%-precision cutoff selection; not the paper's fixed zero-logit rule

prospective_comparison.interpretation: Report pitch presence, extras, misses and complete sets separately at every cardinality. Compare all outcomes to the unaugmented setwise baseline; do not use the rejected transposition result as a moving gate. A single-pitch regression must be disclosed even if the research gates pass.

harmonic_level_suppression.name: harmonic_level_suppression_v1
harmonic_level_suppression.relative_coordinates: All 60 unchanged, including existing numeric floors and clipping
harmonic_level_suppression.scope: All training, held-out and continuous inputs; no extra level gate
harmonic_level_suppression.normalization: Training-only scaler; constant zero columns have mean=0 and scale=1
